description: I’m a creative, responsible, and open-minded person who enjoys teamwork, sharing ideas, and learning new things. I’m looking for motivated, respectful, and cooperative teammates with good communication skills. I believe we can achieve great things together.
summary:
Falcon 9 is preparing for its space mission. After reaching space, it notices a large amount of space debris caused by old satellites that never returned to Earth. Although it is worried about polluting space, it trusts its company and deploys its satellites. Later, it discovers that one of the satellites belongs to its own company. After checking, it realizes that the satellite has a planned return date, meaning the company is responsible and does not want to pollute space. Finally, Falcon 9 feels relieved and decides to return to Earth. 
What we are aiming for is that satellites that have completed their missions return to Earth when the time comes, thus preventing pollution in space.
details:
Space from falcon 9’s point of view uses futuristic storytelling to explore space from a rockets view. Through the main characters journey readers can get information about space pollution.

The project combines real life scientific situations and a rockets thoughts about satellites which completed their missions but did not return to earth causes space pollution. Its intended impact is to inspire curiosity about space, demonstrate the importance of scinentific exploration and encourage environmental responsibility

It's creative approach lies in presenting scientific discoveries through an emotional, action-driven narrative rather than traditional educational material for who don’t have much information about space. Our aim is to make awareness about space pollution and to solve it by writing stories that can read by every person.
